title: Harden what the public repo publishes (box IP/user/paths in deploy/**, the operator's alert address in works/**)
reason: leetusik/Mijual is public; deploy/runbook.md and deploy/edge/README.md carry the box's IP, ssh user and absolute paths, and works/** carries the operator's personal alert address — no credential, but the reconnaissance an attacker starts from. Options: redact the deploy docs, or make the repo private.
trigger: Before the URL is circulated beyond the judges, or immediately if the repo stays public after the contest.
